title: Rejected Claim - candidate examined and disproved during an audit
description: A concern that was raised, independently tested and refuted. Kept so the same claim is not re-raised, and so the report can show what was examined. Rejected claims carry no severity and never affect scoring.

reason_rejected.description: The concrete fact that disproves the claim, with file:line where possible.

source_ref.description: Commit the claim was tested against. A changed source path reopens the claim.
